summary: Indaptus Therapeutics filed an 8-K/A amending its September 1, 2026 report solely to update dilution disclosure tied to Amendment No. 1 of its August 31, 2026 prospectus supplement. On August 28, 2026 the company entered an Amended and Restated At the Market Offering Agreement with H.C. Wainwright, replacing the June 1, 2022 agreement and permitting sales of common stock up to a $100,000,000 aggregate offering price under its Form S-3 shelf. This is a routine ATM program amendment, not a special situation; watch share issuance pace and dilution overhang.
